edition.publication: American reprint of the Edinburgh edition, revised and chronologically arranged with brief prefaces and occasional notes (Buffalo: Christian Literature Publishing Company, 1885)
edition.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume IV: Fathers of the Third Century: Tertullian, Part Fourth; Minucius Felix; Commodian; Origen, Parts First and Second

alternate_titles: Fathers of the Third Century: Tertullian, Part Fourth; Minucius Felix; Commodian; Origen, Parts First and Second
work.author: Alexander Roberts, James Donaldson, and A. Cleveland Coxe
work.description: The fourth volume of the American Ante-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Tertullian's ascetic and disciplinary works (including On Modesty, On Fasting, On Monogamy, To His Wife, On the Apparel of Women, On the Veiling of Virgins, and On Exhortation to Chastity) together with Minucius Felix, Commodian, and Origen. Its container identity remains distinct from the ancient works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume IV
